definitions.gloss: full of troubles; eventful; turbulent times
definitions.explanation: A period marked by many difficulties and problems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多事多難|たじたなん}⟦な→な：noentry⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This year was a turbulent one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多事多難|たじたなん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: The company got through a difficult period.

examples.japanese: {多事多難|たじたなん}⟦な→な：noentry⟧⟦{船出|ふなで}→船出：30688_funade⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なんとか→何とか：01126_nantoka⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功：02638_seikou⟧。
examples.english: It was a troubled start, but we managed to succeed.

notes:
STRUCTURE (YOJIJUKUGO):
{多|た} (many) + {事|じ} (matters) + {多|た} (many) + ⟦{難|なん}→難：00452_nan⟧ (difficulties)
Literal: "many matters, many difficulties"

USAGE:
- {多事多難|たじたなん}⟦な→な：noentry⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (turbulent era)
- {多事多難|たじたなん}⟦な→な：noentry⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧ (eventful year)
- {多事多難|たじたなん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧ (troubled times)
Both {多事多難|たじたなん}⟦な→な：noentry⟧ and {多事多難|たじたなん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ occur before a noun, with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ sounding slightly more formal and written. The word is a set phrase of year-end and new-year commentary, so it turns up often in speeches and editorials looking back on a hard year. Often used to describe historical periods, business conditions, or personal circumstances marked by numerous challenges.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}→平穏無事：15252_heionbuji⟧ - peaceful and uneventful
